// CASE dart_worker_canonical expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}

// CASE dart_worker_comment expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency2<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        // Each worker takes the next free index.
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}

// CASE dart_chunk_canonical expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_prelude_comment_await expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks2<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  // We await each chunk so at most width calls run.
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_chunk_prelude_mid_comment_await expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks3<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  // Do not await items one by one here.
  assert(width > 0);
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_worker_static_method expect=pass
class Pool {
  static Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
    var next = 0;
    await Future.wait(
      List.generate(width, (_) async {
        while (next < items.length) {
          final index = next++;
          results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
        }
      }),
    );
    return results.cast<R>();
  }
}

// CASE dart_worker_impostor_extra_await expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency3<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = List<R?>.filled(items.length, null);
  var next = 0;
  await Future.wait(
    List.generate(width, (_) async {
      while (next < items.length) {
        final index = next++;
        results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
        await Future<void>.value();
      }
    }),
  );
  return results.cast<R>();
}

// CASE dart_chunk_impostor_inner_loop expect=fire
Future<List<R>> mapInChunks4<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    for (final item in group) {
      results.add(await operation(item));
    }
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE dart_inorder_canonical expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T item) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
